تغترفوا (form VIII)
# تَغْتَرِفُوا (taḡtarifū) /taɣ.ta.ri.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
# تُغْتَرَفُوا (tuḡtarafū) /tuɣ.ta.ra.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
